summary: Enable route-level A/B testing Console feature flag + entitlement in staging for internal dogfood
description:
Request type: Internal access/entitlement

Requester: Talia Benson (Program Mgmt)
Team: Console & Rollouts

What we need:
- Enable the Console UI for route-level A/B testing in STAGING for internal testing/dogfood.
- Ensure the backend APIs are accessible (CRUD + start/stop/rollback) for our staging org/project.

Why:
Design + engineering need to validate end-to-end flows (create experiment, validate, start, stop, rollback) and confirm metrics/exposure logging is wired correctly before beta partner enablement.

Scope requested:
- Environment: staging (us-east)
- Org/tenant: rw-internal-dogfood (staging)
- Project: console-ab-dogfood (staging)
- Console entitlement: route-level A/B testing (UI nav + pages)
- Feature flags: console.ab_testing_route_level_beta (or equivalent per Config Service)

Constraints/notes:
- We do NOT need prod access.
- Please keep access limited to Redwood employees only (SSO groups ok).
- If there are guardrails that auto-rollback/disable experiments in staging, that is fine (preferred).

Approvals:
- Product owner approval: Marissa Cole (Console & Rollouts)
- Engineering lead approval: Dylan Brooks (Console & Tooling)
- Security consult: Marcus Lin (ok as long as staging only + RBAC unchanged)

Success criteria:
- Users in the allowed SSO group can see "Experiments (A/B)" in Console for staging.
- We can create an experiment config and start it without 403.
- Audit events appear in staging audit log stream for create/start/stop.

Suggested SSO group (if needed): eng-console-tooling + design-console (or a temporary group created for this dogfood)

References:
- Beta flag wiring PR: sources/github/redwood/pr_18491_feature-flag-console-ab-testing-beta.json
- Runbook (for emergency disable): sources/confluence/eng-platform/runbooks/ab-testing-emergency-disable-and-rollback.json
